activity.notes: Olav II Haraldsson, later Saint Olav, was King of Norway from 1015 to 1028. He was driven from the kingdom before returning and dying at Stiklestad in 1030; ATLAS therefore ends the sovereign Activity in 1028 rather than extending it to his death.

sources.title: Olav den hellige — Store norske leksikon
sources.citation_text: Store norske leksikon identifies Olav II Haraldsson as King of Norway from 1015 to 1028.

sources.title: Norges historie fra 800 til 1130 — Store norske leksikon
sources.citation_text: The history survey likewise gives Olav II's kingship as 1015–1028 and discusses his role in consolidation and Christianization.
